"];const POS={"0":[0,86,43],"1":[0,56,43],"2":[0,71,43],"3":[0,10,43],"4":[0,37,68],"5":[0,60,68],"6":[0,84,68],"7":[0,68,82],"8":[0,78,93],"9":[0,30,94],"10":[1,74,24],"11":[1,23,46],"12":[1,76,46],"13":[1,24,68],"14":[1,75,68],"15":[2,13,6],"16":[2,13,12],"17":[2,13,18],"18":[2,13,24],"19":[2,13,30],"20":[2,22,56],"21":[2,74,56],"22":[2,23,76],"23":[2,73,76],"24":[2,45,90],"25":[3,19,7],"26":[3,70,7],"27":[3,20,14],"28":[3,70,14],"29":[3,46,21],"30":[3,19,34],"31":[3,69,34],"32":[3,20,42],"33":[3,70,42],"34":[3,20,65],"35":[3,72,65],"36":[3,20,78],"37":[3,72,78],"38":[3,20,92],"39":[3,72,92]};
let page=0,current=0,paperScale=1,workScale=1,wrongOnly=false;let answers={};try{answers=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('HT_GS5_DE3_ALIGNED')||'{}')}catch(e){};
const names={A1:'Listening I · Listen and number',A2:'Listening II · Tick or cross',A3:'Listening III · Listen and write',B1:'Reading I · True or False',B2:'Reading II · Choose the answer',C1:'Writing I · Complete the sentences',C2:'Writing II · Reorder the words',D1:'Speaking I · Answer about you',D2:'Speaking II · Look and say'};
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));const clean=s=>String(s||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[.!?]+$/,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ');function save(){try{localStorage.setItem('HT_GS5_DE3_ALIGNED',JSON.stringify(answers))}catch(e){console.warn('Storage unavailable',e)}}
function currentAudio(){let s=Q[current].section;return s==='A1'?0:s==='A2'?1:s==='A3'?2:null}
const audioNodes=AUDIOS.map((src,i)=>{let a=document.createElement('audio');a.controls=true;a.preload='metadata';a.src='data:audio/mpeg;base64,'+src;a.dataset.i=i;return a});
function pauseCurrent(){let i=currentAudio();if(i!==null)audioNodes[i].pause()}
function pageFor(i){return POS[i][0]};function openQuestion(i){current=i;let p=pageFor(i);if(page!==p){page=p;renderPage()}renderQuestion();renderNav();document.getElementById('workScroll').scrollTop=0;highlight()}
function renderPage(){document.getElementById('pageNum').textContent=page+1;document.getElementById('pageBtns').innerHTML=PAGES.map((_,i)=>`<button class="${i===page?'active':''}" onclick="goPage(${i})">Trang ${i+1}</button>`).join('');let width=Math.round(768*paperScale);document.getElementById('paperPct').textContent=Math.round(paperScale*100)+'%';document.getElementById('pdfZoomRange').value=Math.round(paperScale*100);let marks=Q.map((q,i)=>({q,i,pos:POS[i]})).filter(x=>x.pos[0]===page).map(({i,pos})=>`<button title="${esc(Q[i].prompt)}" class="mark ${answers[i]!==undefined?'done':''} ${current===i?'current':''}" style="left:${pos[1]}%;top:${pos[2]}%" onclick="openQuestion(${i})">${i+1}</button>`).join('');document.getElementById('paperWrap').innerHTML=`<div class="paper" style="width:${width}px"><img alt="Đề gốc trang ${page+1}" src="data:image/png;base64,${PAGES[page]}">${marks}</div>`}
function goPage(p){page=p;renderPage();let first=Q.findIndex((q,i)=>pageFor(i)===p);if(first>=0)openQuestion(first);document.getElementById('pdfScroll').scrollTop=0}
function highlight(){document.querySelectorAll('.mark').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('current'));let m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.mark')].find(x=>x.textContent===String(current+1));if(m)m.classList.add('current')}
function renderNav(){let ids=Q.map((q,i)=>i).filter(i=>pageFor(i)===page&&(!wrongOnly||answers[i]!==undefined&&clean(answers[i])!==clean(Q[i].answer)));document.getElementById('nav').innerHTML=`<p class="muted">Các câu thuộc trang ${page+1} — chọn đúng số câu trên đề hoặc tại đây:</p><div class="qgrid">${ids.map(i=>`<button class="qnav ${current===i?'active':''} ${answers[i]!==undefined?'done':''}" onclick="openQuestion(${i})">Câu ${i+1} ${answers[i]!==undefined?'✓':''}</button>`).join('')}</div>`}
function renderQuestion(){let q=Q[current],value=answers[current],done=value!==undefined;document.getElementById('qNumber').textContent=(current+1)+'/40';let a=currentAudio(),bar=document.getElementById('audioBar');bar.classList.toggle('hidden',a===null);if(a!==null){bar.replaceChildren();let lab=document.createElement('label');lab.textContent=['🎧 Listening Part 1','🎧 Listening Part 2','🎧 Listening Part 3'][a];bar.append(lab,audioNodes[a])}let opts=q.opts||[];let content=opts.length?`<div class="opts">${opts.map((v,j)=>`<button ${done?'disabled':''} class="${done&&clean(v)===clean(q.answer)?'right':''} ${done&&clean(v)===clean(value)&&clean(v)!==clean(q.answer)?'wrong':''}" onclick="answerOption(${j})">${esc(v)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`:`<input class="write" id="typed" value="${esc(value||'')}" placeholder="Nhập câu trả lời của em..." ${done?'disabled':''}><button class="next" ${done?'disabled':''} onclick="answerText()">Kiểm tra đáp án</button>`;let feedback=done?`<div class="feedback"><b>${clean(value)===clean(q.answer)?'✓ Chính xác':'Đáp án tham khảo: '+esc(q.answer)}</b><div>${esc(q.why||'')}</div>${q.translation?`<div><b>Dịch / Gợi ý:</b> ${esc(q.translation)}</div>`:''}</div>`:'';document.getElementById('question').innerHTML=`<div class="question"><p class="muted">${esc(names[q.section])}</p><h2>${esc(q.prompt)}</h2><p class="muted">Đối chiếu hình và số câu ở khung PDF bên trái.</p>${content}${feedback}<button class="next" onclick="nextQuestion()">Câu tiếp theo →</button></div>`;document.getElementById('workInner').style.zoom=workScale;document.getElementById('workPct').textContent=Math.round(workScale*100)+'%';document.getElementById('workZoomRange').value=Math.round(workScale*100);stats()}
function answerOption(j){if(answers[current]!==undefined)return;pauseCurrent();answers[current]=Q[current].opts[j];save();renderQuestion();renderNav();renderPage()}
function answerText(){if(answers[current]!==undefined)return;let v=document.getElementById('typed').value.trim();if(!v)return;pauseCurrent();answers[current]=v;save();renderQuestion();renderNav();renderPage()}
function nextQuestion(){openQuestion((current+1)%Q.length)}function stats(){let done=Object.keys(answers).length,correct=Object.entries(answers).filter(([i,v])=>clean(v)===clean(Q[i].answer)).length;document.getElementById('stats').textContent=`Đã làm ${done}/40 · Đúng ${correct}`}
function zoomPaper(delta){paperScale=Math.max(.55,Math.min(2.5,+(paperScale+delta).toFixed(2)));renderPage()}function fitPaper(){let w=document.getElementById('pdfScroll').clientWidth-34;paperScale=Math.min(1.7,Math.max(.55,w/768));renderPage()}function zoomWork(delta){workScale=Math.max(.75,Math.min(2.2,+(workScale+delta).toFixed(2)));renderQuestion()}function fitWork(){workScale=1;renderQuestion()}
function showWrong(){wrongOnly=!wrongOnly;let ids=Q.map((q,i)=>i).filter(i=>answers[i]!==undefined&&clean(answers[i])!==clean(q.answer));if(wrongOnly&&ids.length)openQuestion(ids[0]);else{renderNav();if(wrongOnly)alert('Chưa có câu sai đã trả lời.')} }
function resetExam(){
  // One-click fresh attempt: clear persisted and in-memory answers before repainting.
  answers={};wrongOnly=false;current=0;page=0;
  try{localStorage.removeItem('HT_GS5_DE3_ALIGNED')}catch(e){console.warn(e)}
  save();
  if(typeof audioNodes!=='undefined')audioNodes.forEach(a=>{try{a.pause();a.currentTime=0}catch(e){}});
  openQuestion(0);
  renderNav();renderPage();stats();
  let note=document.getElementById('resetNotice');
  if(!note){note=document.createElement('span');note.id='resetNotice';note.setAttribute('role','status');note.style.cssText='font-weight:700;color:#087443;padding:5px 10px;background:#e9fff1;border-radius:8px';document.querySelector('.controls').appendChild(note)}
  note.textContent='✓ Đã làm mới đề — có thể trả lời lại từ câu 1';
}
function setPaperZoom(v){paperScale=Number(v)/100;renderPage()}
function setWorkZoom(v){workScale=Number(v)/100;renderQuestion()}
function setSplit(percent){percent=Math.max(25,Math.min(80,percent));document.getElementById('splitLayout').style.gridTemplateColumns=`minmax(280px,${percent}fr) 12px minmax(280px,${100-percent}fr)`;}
function toggleFullscreen(id){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(document.fullscreenElement)document.exitFullscreen();else if(el.requestFullscreen)el.requestFullscreen()}
(function(){let dragging=false;const grip=document.getElementById('dividerDrag');grip.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{dragging=true;grip.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);e.preventDefault()});grip.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!dragging)return;const r=document.getElementById('splitLayout').getBoundingClientRect();setSplit((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100)});grip.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>dragging=false);grip.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>dragging=false)})();
setSplit(65);fitPaper();paperScale=Math.max(1.1,paperScale);openQuestion(0);
</script></body></html>
